_comment: Network transport / DNS retry policy for LLM calls. See src/config/retry_transport.py for the loader. Covers transient connection failures (DNS resolution, connection refused/reset, socket and HTTP-client transport errors) raised on the path to Vertex AI — distinct from server-side HTTP 429s, which live in retry_429.json. Exponential-with-jitter backoff because a local network/DNS blip needs a moment to clear, not an immediate retry.
